ValidationRule.description: At least 1 photo required when takeoff is submitted
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator"), (AND( ISPICKVAL(Takeoff_Status__c, "Submitted for Approval"), OR(ISBLANK(Takeoff_Photo_Count__c), Takeoff_Photo_Count__c < 1) )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: At least one site photo required
